rows.en: (I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas.)

(I promised Saotome-kun we'd go to today's party
together, but...)

Merry Christmas,
Saotome-kun.
(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas.)

(I promised Michel we'd go to today's party
together, but...)

Merry Christmas,
Michel.

It's a party, after all.
Let's have all the fun we can.

A Christmas like this isn't half bad, right?
Well, guess we'd better head to the party.

Who'd have thought Klan would get tricked
as usual and end up doing something like that...
It really was a great Christmas.
I hope we can spend next year like this too.

Well, guess it's about time I called it a night.
See you next year.

(I promised Michel-kun we'd go to today's party
together, but...)

Merry Christmas,
Michel-kun.
Yeah, see you next year.

(I promised Luca we'd go to today's party
together, but...)

Merry Christmas,
Luca.

It'd be nice if we could spend next year
like this too, wouldn't it?

(I promised Luca-kun we'd go to today's party
together, but...)

Merry Christmas,
Luca-kun.

It's a party, after all,
so let's enjoy it to the fullest.

(I promised Nanase we'd go to today's party
together, but...)

Merry Christmas,
Nanase.

It's a party, after all,
so let's have all the fun we can.

What are you saying?
Come on, let's hurry to the party.

That's right.
It'd be nice if we could spend next year
like this too.

It's a party, after all,
so let's have all the fun we can, okay?

(I promised Ranka we'd go to today's party
together, but...)

Merry Christmas!
\p-kun!

Merry Christmas,
Ranka.

It's a party, after all,
so let's have as much fun as we can!

A Christmas like this sounds fun too!
Come on, let's hurry to the party!
Yeah, I'm so glad it was such a fun party~

Yeah.
I hope we can spend next year like this too.

Okay, shall we head home now?
See you next year!

(I promised Ranka-chan we'd go to today's party
together, but...)

Merry Christmas!
\p-chan!

Merry Christmas,
Ranka-chan.

(I promised Klan-senpai we'd go to today's party
together, but...)

Merry Christmas,
Klan-senpai.

It's a party, after all!
We're going to make all the noise we can!

Mm, a Christmas like this can't be so bad.
Come on, we're heading to the party.
Man, that was fun~
Mm, that was quite a fun party.
It really turned into a great Christmas.

Indeed.
I hope we can spend next year like this too.

(So today's Valentine's Day...
I hope I get at least one from somebody...)

(...Is what I was hoping, but in the end
nobody gave me any...)

(Getting my hopes up any more will just make
it worse. I'm going home...)
(Sigh...)

(Today's Valentine's Day, but there's nobody
I'm close enough to give chocolate to,
so it's got nothing to do with me.)
(Umm, what are today's classes again...)
(So today's Valentine's Day.)

(I bought chocolate for Kagura-kun, since we
always get along so well, but now that I actually
have to give it to him, I'm nervous...)

(Should I give it, or shouldn't I...
What should I do?)
Give Kagura-kun chocolate
Don't give Kagura-kun chocolate

Here, Kagura-kun.
Some Valentine's chocolate for you.

Oh, that's right, today's Valentine's Day.
Thanks, \p.

I'll have to properly return the favor
on White Day. Hmm, what would be good...

Kagura-kun, you don't need to give
me anything back.

No, it'd be rude not to return it properly.
Look forward to White Day.
Okay, then I'll look forward to it.

(I'm glad I managed to give Kagura-kun the
chocolate. I wonder what he'll give me back
on White Day?)

(Sorry, Kagura-kun, but it's just too
embarrassing. I can't give you the chocolate...)

(Sigh... Guess I'll just have to eat
this chocolate myself...)

(I bought chocolate for Gary-sensei, since he
always looks out for me, but now that I actually
have to give it to him, I'm nervous...)
Give Gary-sensei chocolate
Don't give Gary-sensei chocolate

Gary-sensei,
here's some Valentine's chocolate.

Oh, that's right, today's Valentine's Day.
I'll gladly take it, \p.

Well, now that I've gotten chocolate,
I'd better give you something back
on White Day.

No, really, you don't have to give
me anything back.

I've gotta pay it back properly,
or I wouldn't be much of a man.
Look forward to White Day.
Okay, then I'll look forward to it.

(I'm glad I managed to give Gary-sensei the
chocolate. I wonder what he'll give me back
on White Day?)

(Sorry, Gary-sensei, but it's just too
embarrassing. I can't give you the chocolate...)

(I bought chocolate for Luis-san, since he
always looks out for me, but now that I actually
have to give it to him, I'm nervous...)
Give Luis-san chocolate
Don't give Luis-san chocolate

uncertain: c21731: Michel's 'Klan got tricked as usual and did that' refers to an event the scene never shows; kept vague ('something like that').
c21769: shared by the no-partner male Valentine scene and by every girl-gives-chocolate variant; kept neutral.
c21777: shared by all female-player Valentine variants; written with 'it' (the chocolate) so it fits every recipient.
c21787/c21799: monologue apologises to the absent recipient ('Sorry, Kagura-kun...'); 'you' used as an apostrophe in the monologue, matching the Japanese 'warui kedo'.
